flags.message: gemini-baseline's prediction records input_snapshot "missing" and its reasoning reports record/context.json absent, but its transcript looked under events/<event>/record/ rather than the case-level record/, where the snapshot, context, and application text were present (the other candidate read them in the same run, and the harness-stamped context on gemini-baseline's own prediction carries snapshot_date 2026-09-01). The predictor's own data-quality flag about a missing snapshot therefore looks like a path error, not a provisioning failure; no re-provisioning is indicated.

The stored snapshot (2026-09-04) lists an amicus brief of the Initiative and Referendum Institute submitted Sep 3 2026, after the denial entry the same day; outcome.json records interim_signals.amicus_briefs = 0. Plausibly by design (counted as at disposition) — surfaced only so the outcome writer's reading is visible; no correction made and none proposed.
